source_window.dataset: National Heritage List for England (NHLE) v02 VIEW — Listed Building polygons (layer 3)

first_missing_criterion: Official Historic England Listed Building polygons layer-3 record for ListEntry 1239561 (Nos. 161 and 163 Magdalen Road, Exeter), returning Polygon/MultiPolygon coordinates and bound ListEntry/Name/Grade/AmendDate fields. The current official NHLE record identifies a pair of early-C19 detached villas and records a 19-Jul-2016 amendment, while Historic England's polygon-data terms state that polygons are available for listed buildings listed or substantively amended since 4 April 2011; however the exact single-record query payload was not retrievable through the available retrieval channel, so no polygon coordinates were read or fabricated and no individual building record was accepted.
